title: Normalized boundary transport for native compact support
statement: Specialize the normalized native compact-support cyclic Hom transport statement to its boundary component, for the same D, l, f₀, boundary families bX,bY and native Weil complexes K,H.

source.place: Final exceptional-adjunction sentence, with the native-derived expansion of lem-sf-weil-native-exceptional-forgetful.

proof.text: Choose the actual native compactification. Apply exact cyclic-Hom functoriality to its open extension. Choose the unique natural normalized boundary at the middle scheme using exists_cyclicDerivedHomBoundary. Apply cyclicDerivedCanonicalRight_functorial to the canonical proper pushforward: proper_normalization gives its unit equation after cancelling the forgetful exact-factor isomorphism. The exact open extension preserves boundedness. Compose the two transports by expanding their comparison isomorphisms and shift maps, and restrict to the full subcategory of Weil complexes. Take the boundary projection.
